Fixed Deposits & Wealth Products Master Guidelines (FB-POL-FDW-2026-V3) | Section 2: Premature Liquidation and Penalties
• Premature Withdrawal Permitted: Customers may break or liquidate their Fixed Deposit at any time through the FinBase App.
• Premature Penalty: A penalty of 1.00% is deducted from the contracted interest rate applicable for the period the FD actually remained open.
• 7-Day Minimum Holding Rule: If a Fixed Deposit is closed prematurely within 7 days from the booking date, zero interest is payable under RBI regulations.

text:
Fixed Deposits & Wealth Products Master Guidelines (FB-POL-FDW-2026-V3) | Section 3: Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) & Form 15G / 15H
• TDS Threshold: TDS is deducted at 10% if the total annual interest income across all deposits exceeds ₹40,000 in a financial year (₹50,000 for senior citizens).
• Non-PAN Penalty: If a valid PAN is not linked to the customer account, TDS is statutorily deducted at 20%.
• Zero TDS Exemption (Form 15G/15H):
• Depositors whose estimated total annual income is below the taxable threshold may submit Form 15G (for individuals below 60 years) or Form 15H (for senior citizens aged 60+) digitally via the FinBase App to avoid TDS deduction.

text:
Fixed Deposits & Wealth Products Master Guidelines (FB-POL-FDW-2026-V3) | Section 22: Explicit Product Exclusions & Unsupported Services Policy
To prevent customer confusion and combat financial scams, FinBase explicitly defines services that are strictly NOT offered or supported on its platform:
• Cryptocurrency & Virtual Digital Assets: FinBase does NOT provide cryptocurrency trading, Bitcoin/Ethereum wallets, or virtual digital asset exchange facilities.
• Agricultural Property Loans: FinBase does NOT offer loans against agricultural farmland or rural mortgage loans.
• Speculative Intraday Tips: FinBase does NOT provide daily stock market intraday calls, F&O options tips, or speculative trading advice.
• Unregulated Chit Funds / Ponzi Schemes: Strictly prohibited under compliance governance.
Customer support assistants must clearly state that these services are unsupported and unavailable in the FinBase knowledge base.

Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP (FB-SOP-PAY-2026-V4) | Section 1: UPI Limits and 24-Hour Security Cooling Period
• Standard Daily UPI Limit: Up to ₹1,00,000 per calendar day across peer-to-peer (P2P) transfers.
• Transaction Frequency Limit: Maximum 20 outbound UPI payments per rolling 24-hour window.
• First 24-Hour Cooling Period Security Restriction:
• Whenever a customer links a new bank account or resets their UPI PIN, NPCI security protocols enforce a strict cooling period.
• Outward UPI payments are restricted to a maximum cumulative limit of ₹5,000 for the initial 24 hours following the PIN reset.
• Full ₹1,00,000 daily limit automatically unlocks exactly 24 hours after PIN registration.

doc_title: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP
title: Failed Transactions and Auto-Reversal Turnaround Time (TAT)
citation: Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP (FB-SOP-PAY-2026-V4) — Section 2, p.1
text:
Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP (FB-SOP-PAY-2026-V4) | Section 2: Failed Transactions and Auto-Reversal Turnaround Time (TAT)
When money is debited from a customer's account but the transaction fails or the beneficiary does not receive the credit:
• Mandatory Auto-Reversal TAT: Under RBI and NPCI Harmonization of TAT guidelines, failed transactions must be automatically reversed and credited back to the customer's account within T+2 business days (where T is the transaction date).
• Delayed Reversal Compensation:
• If the reversal takes longer than T+2 business days, FinBase compensates the customer ₹100 per calendar day of delay.
• Compensation is calculated from the expiry of the T+2 window until the exact credit date, deposited directly into the customer's account without requiring any manual claim submission.

Section 6.1: Part-Prepayment Terms
• Part-prepayment is permitted only after completing a minimum of 6 consecutive monthly EMI cycles from the disbursal date.
• Borrowers may part-prepay up to 25% of the current outstanding principal balance once per financial year without attracting any penalty.
• If part-prepayment exceeds 25% of the outstanding principal in a single financial year, an administrative charge of 1.0% + GST is levied on the amount exceeding the 25% threshold.

• The applicable foreclosure charge is 3% of the outstanding principal if the loan is closed prior to completing 24 months of the repayment tenure.
• If the loan is foreclosed after completing 24 months, the foreclosure charge is reduced to 1.5% of the outstanding principal.
• Full foreclosure is strictly not permitted within the initial 6 months from loan disbursal under any circumstances.
• Foreclosure requests can be initiated directly via the FinBase App under 'Loans -> Service Requests -> Foreclose Loan'.
